summary: Grafana Enterprise licensing and tenant consolidation for infra metrics
description:
Request: Purchase Grafana Enterprise annual subscription and migrate two existing orgs (infra-redwood and infra-experimental) into a single consolidated tenant under the Platform cost center. Purpose is to centralize dashboards, reduce per-seat costs through volume pricing, and enable unified SSO/SCIM provisioning.

Background: Platform and SRE teams run critical dashboards in two separate Grafana Cloud orgs created at different times. This complicates onboarding, increases license overhead, and makes alert rules and plugin policies inconsistent. We want a consolidated Enterprise plan with SAML + SCIM + backend snapshot retention SLA.

Deliverables:
- Purchase order and contract signed for consolidated Grafana Enterprise (12-month term)
- SCIM/SSO integration completed using Okta IdP and existing group mappings
- Migration runbook and dry-run executed for non-critical dashboards
- Inventory updated in asset-management and billing tags assigned to cost center
impact: Moderate internal cost savings and operational simplification. Current duplication leads to excess licensing spend (~$18k/year) and duplicated alert noise; consolidation reduces ship friction for new services. No customer-facing downtime expected but potential brief dashboard access inconsistency during migration windows.
cost_estimate: $28,500 annual (estimated after volume discount). Includes enterprise features, 120 seats, and upgraded retention. Final quote pending vendor negotiation.
approvals_required: Finance approval for PO (Cost center: Platform-OPS-42), Security review sign-off for third-party data retention and plugin policy, Legal review of enterprise terms and data processing addendum (DPA).
steps_to_execute:
1) Approve budget and issue PO to Grafana sales contact.
2) Request vendor onboarding packet from procurement and complete W-9 and banking details.
3) Security runs vendor questionnaire and flag any additional controls; if required, raise follow-up SSO/SCIM controls.
4) Provision consolidated Grafana org; configure SAML + SCIM using Okta test tenant.
5) Run migration dry-run for infra-experimental dashboards (non-critical) during maintenance window.
6) Execute final migration and verify alerting and plugin compatibility.
7) Update internal asset inventory, notify teams, and close ticket.
